primary_population: quality_usable & independent_vote_eligible & condition=manual & quality_use=ordinary_primary; 5719 answers, 177 images, 22 buildings
secondary_population: all other formally quality-eligible records; condition, quality-use and bound reference remain separate

distance.pairing: only inherited alternating top,bottom pairs in frozen declared ring
distance.cyclic: a common cyclic index shift of complete bound pairs
distance.reversal: not permitted in primary; diagnostic reversal sensitivity retains bound top/bottom endpoints and does not modify source
distance.pixel_convention: +0.5 vertical pixel center inherited exactly; 1024x512 coordinates
distance.different_pair_counts: no whole-layout distance, separate clustering subpools; never numeric imputation

partition.primary: maximize sum(max(0,1-d/tau)^2) over within-cluster pairs subject to all within-cluster d<=tau and binary transitivity
partition.implementation: same binary pair/transitivity MILP; exact decomposition by allowed-edge connected components; complete components attain sum-of-all-weights upper bound
partition.nonoptimal_status: retain feasible result, incumbent objective, bound, gap and timeout; no claim of certified optimality
partition.comparison: complete linkage using the identical distance and thresholds
partition.stability: report threshold coassignment changes, complete-link input-order reversal, affinity vs complete coassignment, and zero/near-zero threshold margins; deterministic small non-clique components have a no-good-constraint alternative-optimum check at 1e-7 objective tolerance
partition.no_tuning: no image-specific threshold, no Q, time, reference score or fusion output in cluster definition

team_oracle_rules.largest_cluster_first: rank local clusters by descending size then sorted object IDs; select from first cluster then subsequent clusters as required, uniform random order within each cluster
team_oracle_rules.cluster_balanced: round-robin across clusters sorted descending size then sorted object IDs, uniform random within each cluster
team_oracle_rules.composition_variants: same fixed cluster-count vector, independent uniform member identities within each cluster, 4 draws at every feasible k for largest-first and balanced vectors
team_oracle_rules.pure_major_cluster: k random distinct members of the largest cluster only where its size>=k; 4 draws
team_oracle_rules.path_orders: largest-first block order and balanced round-robin, using actual local clusters; explanatory/oracle only, not prospective personnel selection
team_oracle_rules.comparisons: same image,k,background,reference,fusion settings; within-vs-cross local cluster swaps at same point count separately from different-point-count swaps; exact cluster-count composition and member turnover held fixed for replacement-of-identities comparisons

practical_tolerances.quality_near: both complete and |delta B8L2|<=2 points; D10 reported on same teams
practical_tolerances.structure_unchanged: same output node count and same available frozen ring/connection identity diagnostic; missing correspondence remains unknown
practical_tolerances.geometry_near: range_near plus available bound-cyclic output endpoint distance<=3 degrees; different pair counts fail geometry-near
practical_tolerances.joint_near: quality_near & geometry_near & structure_unchanged, with failures/unknowns retained in attempted denominator
practical_tolerances.interpretation: exploratory practical screens fixed before outputs, not user-approved production thresholds; no null-effect claim from a nonsignificant p-value

reverse_to_forward_validation.unit: ordinary-Manual local-cluster coassignment and largest-cluster membership, labels meaningful only per image
reverse_to_forward_validation.primary_validation: leave one building out; both worker predictors and response-type outcome models learned excluding target building
reverse_to_forward_validation.predictors: training-only worker Q, source-T, joint difficulty effects from profile agent; target difficulty is observable, target worker Q/point count/cluster label not used as prospective predictors
reverse_to_forward_validation.baselines: training difficulty-stratified prevalence and smoothed historical worker-pair coassignment; no cross-image cluster-ID matching
reverse_to_forward_validation.models: fixed L2 logistic models with train-standardized continuous Q/T/difficulty features; no outcome-guided feature or class tuning
reverse_to_forward_validation.sensitivity: same-point-count pair subset is explicitly retrospective diagnostic; practical swap-impact features use same outer-building split
reverse_to_forward_validation.uncertainty: building-equal summaries and building bootstrap; image-level and existing direct room-group-equal weighting sensitivities; repeated pairs/orders do not create independent humans

geometry_diagnostics.raw_3d: reuse research_round_20260929.reconstruct with continuous coordinates; camera height is a scale unit, not measured depth
geometry_diagnostics.report: bound endpoint angle, floor 1-IoU, mean-height-prism IoU difference, relative mean height and matched radius change; bottom-y near-horizon sensitivity
geometry_diagnostics.perturbation: diagnostic +/-1 and +/-5 vertical pixels for bottom endpoints, inherits published ray projection; never changes source or weights
geometry_diagnostics.visual_review: case selection from complete distributions: strongest 2D-near/3D-far, largest within-cluster swap, small cross-cluster swap, high-Q structural omission candidate; select whole clusters/teams, never ask user to review every pair
